name: Redash
tagline: Open source dashboarding and SQL queries. Connect to any data source.
shortDescription: Redash is an open source dashboarding and SQL query tool. Connect to 30+ data sources, write SQL, build dashboards, schedule queries, share. The mature open source BI for SQL-first teams.
longDescription:
## What it is

Redash is an open source dashboarding and SQL query tool. 30+ data source integrations (Postgres, MySQL, BigQuery, Snowflake, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, etc.), write SQL, build visualizations, dashboards, schedule queries, share via links, alerts.

## Why we recommend it

If you want a simple, mature, open source BI tool that focuses on SQL (not visual query builders), Redash is the answer. It's been around since 2013 and is widely deployed.

## When to use it

- SQL-first BI for a small/medium team
- When you want 30+ data source integrations
- Scheduling and sharing SQL queries
- When Metabase feels too opinionated
installInstructions:
**Docker Compose (recommended):**
```
git clone https://github.com/getredash/redash
cd redash
docker compose up -d
```
UI at http://localhost:5000.

**Note:** Redash is in maintenance mode. Consider Metabase or Superset for new deployments.
pricingDetails: Free. BSD-2-Clause licensed. Note: in maintenance mode.
